entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Duncan Alvin MacPherson was a Canadian professional ice hockey player. In 1989, he went on a trip to Austria, and then disappeared. Searches proved fruitless, until 2003 when his body was found in a melting glacier. His death remains officially unsolved.
